programme.title: Same Lies New Loops

programme.title: He Answered
programme.desc: Pastor Steven gives us three things to remember when life is hard. The enemy wants to keep us circling the wilderness, but God will bring us through as we learn to repeat what leads us to victory.

programme.title: Not Here
programme.desc: The enemy wants people to believe God's not listening, but the truth is He hears people; His presence is with us in the mountains and the valleys, and He's working one moment at a time.

programme.title: Keep It In Context
programme.desc: When you feel surrounded by pressure and fear, it's easy to lose perspective. But what if God's already provided the help you've been praying for? Keep it in context: the battle isn't proof you're losing, it's evidence that you're carrying something.

programme.title: Your Label Is Lying
programme.desc: This sermon is for someone who has been hearing the same lies from the enemy for so long that you've started to believe them. But you are not your issue. You are not your bad decision. It's time to interrupt your story with truth and leave the lies.

programme.title: Begin With Amen
programme.desc: There are seasons and situations we write off -- God could never use that; but Jesus knew about it when He found you and He's got a plan to redeem it; you can't see it yet.

programme.title: Begin With Amen
programme.desc: There are seasons and situations we write off -- God could never use that; but Jesus knew about it when He found you and He's got a plan to redeem it; you can't see it yet.

programme.title: Faith to Stay
programme.desc: When we're going through a season that's uncomfortable or uncertain, we often look for a way out; but Jesus demonstrates another way that leads to lasting transformation and fulfillment if we have the faith to follow His example.

programme.title: Stop Staring At That Stone
programme.desc: Have you ever noticed how two people can be looking at the same thing and have completely different perspectives on it? One might see a problem while the other sees a reason to praise. There might be something in your life that looks like a problem.

programme.title: I Thought It Was Through
programme.desc: When despair sets in, it's easy to assume it'll always be this way. But what if a shift in thinking could break that cycle? Your thoughts have the power to disrupt your despair.

programme.title: When God Gives a Thought to You
programme.desc: We live in a world that values things more than thoughts, so when God speaks to us, we don't always value it like we should; we learn some of the ways God speaks, when to ask for it and how to recognize it when He does.

programme.title: The Hardest Part Is Behind You
programme.desc: Don't judge any one part of your life in isolation or let unmet expectations define your future; God's not finished with your story, and He didn't bring you this far to let you turn back now.

programme.title: Not as Long as My Song!
programme.desc: Hitting your limit isn't a sign of weakness; it's an invitation to shift your perspective; when the enemy brings the battle to your mind, remember that he only attacks what's valuable; God's goodness is your secret weapon to win the fight.

programme.title: Not as Long as My Song!

programme.title: Hand Him The Plan
